description: This file implements the core logic for handling execution approval requests and responses over Unix domain sockets, including socket server management, client request handling, and UI prompts for user decision-making in a macOS application.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the socket server that handles incoming execution approval requests and triggers user prompts.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptPresenter
classes.description: Handles presenting a macOS NSAlert dialog to the user for decision-making regarding execution commands, including building the UI and processing user responses.

classes.name: ExecHostExecutor
classes.description: Handles executing commands after approval, including validation, permission checks, and managing the execution flow asynchronously.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard
classes.description: Provides utility functions to validate, create, and clean up socket paths, ensuring socket paths are secure and compliant.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a decision from the external socket, with a timeout, returning an approval decision or nil.

methods.name: requestDecisionSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous socket request to get an approval decision, managing socket creation, connection, message sending, and response parsing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server, initializing and listening for incoming client connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a macOS alert dialog prompting the user to approve or deny a command, returning their decision.

methods.name: buildAccessoryView
methods.description: Constructs the macOS UI view displaying command and context details for user approval.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main handler for incoming host requests, executing validation, prompting, permission checks, and command execution flow.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes the specified command with environment and timeout settings, returning the structured response.
